strategy.summary: Six mutants in src/pricing.js survive because the tests don't assert at the boundaries (subtotal exactly 50 for shipping, exactly 100 for SAVE20), two applyCoupon tests assert nothing useful, and orderTotal is only tested where shipping is 0. Strengthen the two weak applyCoupon tests with exact values (keeping titles and existing assertions) and add boundary cases plus an orderTotal case where shipping is charged, all in test/pricing.test.js, with expectations taken from the README and JSDoc.
inScope: applyCoupon SAVE20 condition (code and subtotal > 100, both sides)
orderTotal adding shipping to the discounted subtotal
outOfScope: The 2 mutants no test reaches (missing coverage, not this run's to add)
Restructuring existing tests beyond adding assertions
assumptions: README and JSDoc state intended behaviour: free shipping at $50 or more, SAVE20 only over $100 (exactly $100 is not discounted), total = discounted + shipping rounded to the cent.

risks.description: Boundary rules could regress unnoticed (off-by-one at $50/$100) and charge customers wrongly

acceptanceCriteria.text: Shipping is free for a subtotal of exactly $50
applyCoupon leaves the subtotal unchanged without the SAVE20 code, even on a large order
SAVE20 does not discount a subtotal of $100 or less
orderTotal adds the $4.99 shipping to an order under $50

testCases.title: handles an order without a coupon
testCases.expected: returns 200 (existing test strengthened with an exact assertion)
testCases.rationale: Kills mutants 1 (code==='SAVE20' → true) and 2 (&& → ||): both would give 160.

testCases.title: leaves a large order unchanged with a code other than SAVE20
testCases.rationale: Kills mutants 1 and 2 with a wrong code rather than none; pins 'any other code changes nothing'.

testCases.title: handles a small order with the coupon
testCases.expected: returns 50 (existing toBeDefined kept, exact assertion added)
testCases.rationale: Kills mutant 4 (subtotal > 100 → true), which would give 40.

testCases.title: does not discount an order of exactly $100 with SAVE20
testCases.rationale: Kills mutant 5 (> 100 → >= 100), which would give 80; also kills mutant 4.

testCases.title: ships an order of exactly $50 for free
adds shipping to the total of a small order
testCases.rationale: Kills mutant 6 (discounted + shipping → discounted - shipping), which would give 15.01.

strategy.environmentNotes: None; pure unit tests run with `npm test` (vitest run).
